Grand Coteau Police asks for help in November shooting GRAND COTEAU, La. ( KLFY ) — The Grand Coteau Police Department is asking for your help in solving a shooting about a year ago .
 Sedrick Lionel Woodson was arrested in July and charged with attempted murder in connection with the shooting on Nov. 23, 2025 that injured two juveniles, authorities said.
 Officials said this is the first phase of enforcement, with additional arrests expected to follow.
 Anyone with additional information regarding this case is asked to contact the Grand Coteau Police Department or submit an anonymous tip through St. Landry Crime Stoppers.
